description:
run_bash_command/2 calls System.shell/2 synchronously inside handle_event, freezing the render loop for the duration. Move execution to Task.start: create the BashExecution entry immediately (status :running), append to transcript, run the shell in background, send {:bash_done, id, output, exit_code} back to the Interactive loop, update the entry on receipt.

Affected file: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex
title: Fix ! bash blocking — run shell commands in a Task
